name: Fondation Beyeler
funding: CHF 30M budget. Basel-Stadt and Riehen give about 9%; the Beyeler Foundation covers a 27% deficit. Sponsors include UBS (Artist Talks) and Globus.
watch: UBS paid a $100M US Federal Reserve fine in 2004 for dollar trading with Iran and other sanctioned countries.
records_note: No annual reports or accounts found; sponsors appear as unlabelled undated logos, and the team page does not list a foundation board.

name: Fondation CAB
funding: Founded 2012 by Hubert Bonnet (Forges de Clabecq steel heir, real estate); partners Pictet, BNP Paribas Fortis, De Bethune, Duvel; members pay EUR 500-2,000.
watch: The founder is the sole funder; the wealth is steel (family sold its Clabecq stake in 1974) and property. Banks Pictet and BNP Paribas Fortis are partners but not under campaign.
records_note: Names about 70 supporters, undated, with partners as logos; it posts no annual report or accounts and lists no board.

name: Fondation Donwahi
funding: Founder Illa Donwahi's own funds (agribusiness), private patrons and annual partner grants.
records_note: The foundation has no working website: its domain is a for-sale page. No reports, accounts, funder list or board were found anywhere.

name: Fondation H
funding: Fondation H philanthropic endowment; non-profit recognized public interest foundation, 100% free entry.
watch: Non-profit contemporary art foundation in a renovated 1900 postal building; entry is free.
records_note: Shows 20 partner logos with no names or date; posts no annual reports or accounts, and names only its president and staff.

name: Fondation Ifitry
funding: Run under Maroc Premium Foundation, which has overseen the Casablanca Biennale and the Essaouira art centre since 2014. No funder list is published.
watch: Artist residency near Essaouira founded in 2008 by Mostapha Romli. The ifitry.ma site no longer resolves.
records_note: It has no site of its own; its parent biennale shows 2021 partner logos without names, with no reports, accounts or board.

name: Fondation Zinsou
funding: Private patronage, budget about 1M EUR in 2015. Zinsou family and major patrons, plus BNP Paribas, Institut français, AFD, Masathis and Open Society Foundations (patron lists, undated).
watch: Free entry. Patrons include Kamel Mennour and Hassanein Hiridjee of Axian. The 50-company figure is not published.
records_note: Names its patrons in two circles, undated, but posts no annual reports, accounts or board list.

name: Fondazione Antonio Ratti
watch: Based at Villa Sucota on Lake Como. Since 1995 its CSAV Artists' Research Laboratory has been directed by invited international artists.

name: Fondazione Morra Greco
funding: Regione Campania, Italian Ministry of Culture, Morra Greco Foundation; certified non-profit cultural foundation.
watch: Housed in the restored 16th-century Palazzo Caracciolo di Avellino in central Naples. No commercial gallery dealing.

name: Fondazione Sandretto Re Rebaudengo
funding: Private foundation of Patrizia Sandretto Re Rebaudengo; family links to Asja Energy (renewables).
records_note: FSRR posts a yearly social report with accounts for 2021 to 2025, names its board, and names four partners on an undated page.

name: Fotogalleriet
funding: Arts and Culture Norway (Kulturdirektoratet), City of Oslo; non-profit foundation.
watch: The Nordic region's oldest institution for lens-based and photographic art; artist-run and publicly funded.

name: Fotomuseum Winterthur
funding: City of Winterthur gives CHF 738k a year for 2025-2032; also Canton of Zurich, Verein, Volkart Stiftung, Ringier, Monterosa and about 20 foundations.
watch: Name to know: the Krupp foundation, a funder that holds 10% of warship builder TKMS and 21% of thyssenkrupp.
records_note: Annual reports 2019 to 2024 include accounts and named partners and patrons; the Stiftungsrat is named on the About page.

name: Frac Centre-Val de Loire
funding: Région Centre-Val de Loire, Ministère de la Culture (DRAC); public contemporary art collection.
